environment.observed_identity: ZoneTree 1.9.7.0; WAL=AsyncCompressed; mutable segment default 1,000,000 items
environment.client_transport: embedded ZoneTree 1.9.7.0, one shared LSM per tree, AsyncCompressed write-ahead log

limits: embedded reference: the measured member is this driver's own process, so the load generator and the database share one resource envelope
LSM with the default 1,000,000-item mutable segment: the whole working set stays in the mutable segment, writes are AsyncCompressed WAL appends, and no disk segment forms during measurement
the write lane maintains the primary zone and the secondary (tenant, name) zone explicitly — the KV-store analogue of SQLite's two B-trees per indexed upsert
async mode: recent writes can be lost if the process terminates before the background WAL work is durable; durability is deferred, not caller-waited
